svg.text: End-to-End Autonomous System Architecture & Data Pipeline

g.text: Non-invasive system call interception in kernel space
• Lockless 256 KB memory buffer allocated per-CPU
• High-throughput event delivery without packet drops
• Serializes structured binary events: PID, PPID, Comm, Payload
• Looks up target PIDs in deny_exec_map hash table
• Denies unauthorized execution with -EPERM in sub-microseconds
• Nodes: Process (PID/PPID), File Paths, Network Sockets (IP:Port)
• Maintains continuous historical lineage from process creation
• Enables sub-graph context extraction for security reasoning
Translates live graph relationships into numerical behavioral feature vectors
• Unsupervised decision tree ensemble evaluating 4D feature vector
• Isolates statistical anomalies based on tree path length
• Pre-trained on empirical benign developer & system workflows
• Calibrates raw scores against offline non-conformity baseline
• Yields valid mathematical p-value with guaranteed False Positive bounds
• Computes dynamic Trust Score (0–100%): High Trust (>75%), Low Trust (<30%)
• Built-in bypass for Linux daemons: dwm, pipewire, udev-worker
• Operator 'Mark Known' decisions stored persistently on disk
• Eliminates repeat false alarms across reboots and service restarts
• Logs anomaly score to audit log
• Sends atomic SIGSTOP to suspicious process
• Freezes execution in RAM without killing process
• Displays amber banner on dashboard for triage
• Snapshots process memory via criu dump
• Replays in isolated netns with virtual sinkhole
• Proves C2 callback intention before taking action
• Audits termination event in Action Log
• Process Table & Search: Live PID/Comm search & filter
• D3.js Provenance Graph: Interactive force-directed node graph
• Process Inspector: Detail card showing sockets, files & actions
• Real-Time Action Log: Real-time audit history of every kill/pause/trust
• Mode Selector: Live switching between Observe, Pause, Enforce
• MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: Grounds analysis in 12 core Linux TTPs
• Contextual Ingestion: Live graph sub-trees & action history
• Zero-Latency Fallback: Template engine when cloud API is offline
• Security Analyst Triage: Explains why processes were flagged
Converts analyst conversation into direct kernel-level actions
